coverage_snapshot.selection: All source-reviewed Nov25-28 records represented by the seven declared edition packages at this snapshot, including the completed p220 C/p221 A appeal. This is not coverage of all surviving same-period traffic or future editions.

limits: The two lexical anchors were selected to propose the assignment and are not independent held-out controls.
Four inconvenient raw9 occurrences are retained; their E/E/E/S source-coordinate repairs predate this hypothesis. No universal error-free substitution claim is made.

The 23 ordinary-letter anchors and the 13 released labels are assumptions of this layer. Earlier rank/geometry choices and every prior source repair remain conditional exactly as in their source packages.
No original digit meanings, money values, dates, unit numbers, Q or Y assignment are inferred. In particular rawJ is not silently reassigned to 9.
Pointwise domains share one global 36-cell bijection. The 12 unassigned cells cannot be independently selected at each plaintext occurrence.
Each supplied full-square/erasure witness is arbitrary and demonstrates consistency only; it is not a proposed original reading.
Coverage is the frozen 23-record source-reviewed snapshot, not all surviving Nov25-28 traffic or future editions.
This overlay adds zero source-coordinate edits, zero missing coordinates and no change to data/keys.json or source packages.
